== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ＩＴ－Ｏ（アイティー・オー）</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">支配フェイズに「監房ブロック回廊」にいるなら、その位置での自分のフォース消耗に＋Ｘ。Ｘ＝その場にいる捕虜の人数、である。このドロイドは「行動規制ボルト」の影響を受けない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">浮遊式の捕虜尋問用ドロイド。注射針で自白剤を投与し、診断器具で“手術”を施す。センサーで、対象がどの程度の苦痛に耐えられるか、真実を話しているかなどを判断できる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)]].

'''Lore''' — A floating prisoner interrogation droid. It gives truth drugs with a syringe needle and performs surgery with diagnostic tools. Sensors can judge how much pain the subject can endure and whether the subject is telling the truth.

'''Game text''' — If at Detention Block Corridor during the control phase, your Force drains there are +X. X equals the number of captives present. This droid is not affected by Restraining Bolt.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The power line prints 尋問用ドロイド instead of ability. Detention Block Corridor is 「監房ブロック回廊」. Restraining Bolt is 「行動規制ボルト」, and the droid is not affected rather than immune. The Force drain bonus matches.<ref>[[:File:ANewHope-D-ito-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)]].</ref>
